original:
कृष्णस्तु भगवान् स्वयम् ।
इन्द्रारिव्याकुलं लोकं मृडयन्ति युगे युगे ॥
sanskrit:
कृष्णस्तु भगवान् स्वयम् ।
इन्द्रारिव्याकुलं लोकं मृडयन्ति युगे युगे ॥
transliteration:
kṛṣṇas tu bhagavān svayam |
indrāri-vyākulaṃ lokaṃ mṛḍayanti yuge yuge ||
translation: All the incarnations are either plenary portions or portions of the plenary portions of the Lord, but Lord Sri Krishna is the original Personality of Godhead Himself.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: समस्त अवतार भगवान के अंश अथवा कला हैं, किन्तु भगवान श्रीकृष्ण स्वयं साक्षात् परब्रह्म परमात्मा हैं।

layers.author: sant_eknath
layers.content: सर्व अवतार हे भगवंताचे अंश आहेत, परंतु भगवान श्रीकृष्ण हे साक्षात परिपूर्ण परब्रह्म आहेत.

layers.author: sridhara_swami
layers.content: The central Paribhasha Sutra of the entire Srimad Bhagavatam, establishing the ontological supremacy of Sri Krishna.

layers.author: prabhupada
layers.content: Canto 10 is the very heart and sweet countenance of the Bhagavata, singing the divine leelas in Vrindavan and Mathura.
